sources.name: Town of Castle Rock calendar (CRgov.com)
sources.notes: Checked 6 October 2026: the Town's site is CivicPlus behind Cloudflare and answered 403 ('Sorry, you have been blocked', civicplus.io) to the home page, to the standard CivicPlus feed /RSSFeed.aspx?ModID=58&CID=All-calendar.xml, and to /ParksandRec. The same 403 was reported for an earlier automated request, so this repeats; recorded and not tried another way. Search results show the Town has a CivicPlus /Calendar.aspx with categories (calendar.aspx?CID=18 appeared in results) and an America 250 events page, but none of it was readable from here. Manual until the Town answers or an editor checks it by hand in a browser. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own). Feed found 10 November 2026: the CivicPlus calendar RSS now answers. https://www.crgov.com/RSSFeed.aspx?ModID=58&CID=All-calendar.xml returned 200 text/xml to a browser User-Agent and to this repo's own, with 15 items, which is a cap: the next 15 entries of every calendar, 11 to 21 November, 12 of them meetings, hearings and a closure. The category feed recorded here as feedUrl, CID=Events-18 ('Town of Castle Rock - Calendar - Events'), returned 4 items, everything that calendar holds: Town offices closed for Veterans Day (11 November), Castle Rock Historical Society & Museum's Monthly Presentation (12 November, 7 pm, Philip and Jerry Miller Library), Tree Lighting Celebration (14 November, Outlets at Castle Rock) and Castle Rock Starlighting (21 November, 2 pm). So 3 public events in the next 30 days, each with calendarEvent:EventDates, EventTimes and Location, which scripts/lib/feeds/rss.ts read correctly. Caveats: /robots.txt itself answers 403 (Cloudflare), so the site's rules cannot be read; the script treats an unreadable 4xx robots.txt as no rules, but CivicPlus's stock robots.txt (read today on elbertcounty-co.gov) disallows /RSSFeed.aspx, so the Town's very likely does too. Of 32 category feeds requested a second apart, 2 came back as the Cloudflare challenge page; the HTML pages (/, /Calendar.aspx, /iCalendar.aspx, /rss.aspx, the iCalendar.aspx feed) are still 403. Because this entry is already confirmed, changing type would start ingest reading it at once, so type is left manual with the feed recorded, as on Elizabeth's pplibraries-org: set type to rss to turn it on (and robots to subscribe if the owner decides the published RSS is meant for this). 'Town offices closed' would want an excludeTitles entry.

sources.name: Douglas County events (douglasco.gov)
sources.notes: Checked 6 October 2026: WordPress with The Events Calendar; douglas.co.us redirects/canonicalises to douglasco.gov. The Tribe REST feed read successfully: 40 upcoming events, 2026-10-09 to 2027-01-18, all America/Denver, with structured venue (id, city) and categories. Sample titles: Rueter-Hess Advisory Board, Stargazing Party at Sandstone Ranch, Baby Cafe, Douglas County Fair Board meeting, Planning Commission, Business Meeting, Veterans Day (Offices Closed). Venues: Philip S. Miller Building, Castle Rock (18 of 40), BoCC Hearing Room, Castle Rock (5), Douglas County Fairgrounds, Castle Rock (1), the rest in Parker, Highlands Ranch, Englewood, Larkspur. Mostly public meetings and office closures, so the exclude list and a Castle Rock location filter are needed; the useful public categories are 'Open Space Events' (89 all-time), 'Senior Events' (64), 'Fairgrounds' (5), 'Older Adult Roadshows' (14). The categories endpoint /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/categories was also read. The iCal export https://www.douglas.co.us/events/?ical=1 answered with only 14 VEVENTs (list-view window), so JSON is the better feed. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).

sources.notes: Found 10 November 2026: Ecclesia is the downtown market hall at 221 Perry Street (Sinners & Saints bar, Sudden Fiction Books, Wild & Blume, Apres Coffee and others); its site is WordPress with The Events Calendar at /music-events/. The Tribe REST feed read from today onward: 18 upcoming events, 16 in the next 30 days under 12 titles, every venue 'Sinners & Saints, 221 Perry St, Castle Rock', with the feed's own categories. Live Music (5): Western Night with Brandon Helder (12 November), Live Music at the Altar on Fridays at 8 pm (Guy and Norm 13 November, Derek Hall 20, Chance Gallagher 27, André LaMotte 4 December). One-offs (3): Book Bingo Night (11 November), Fall Floral Workshop with Wild & Blume (15), Bonsai and Cocktails (17). Weekly regulars (8): Make & Mingle on Tuesdays (category Arts & Crafts), Live DJ in the Lounge on Saturdays (category Nightlife), Bingo every Wednesday (Bingo & Games). So about 8 listable; for the editor, excludeTitles 'Make & Mingle', 'Live DJ in the Lounge', 'Bingo at Sinners & Saints', or includeCategories 'Live Music' plus the one-offs by hand. The iCal export /music-events/?ical=1 also answered, with the same 18 VEVENTs. Blocker: robots.txt has 'Disallow: /*?' (and Crawl-delay 3), which catches every URL with a query string, so both the iCal export and the REST call ingest builds (it adds per_page and start_date) are disallowed under robots: honor; the bare REST path is allowed. Reading it needs the owner's decision on robots: subscribe, or a word with Ecclesia.

sources.name: Live Well Douglas County (county-wide events listing)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. A county lifestyle site (WordPress, The Events Calendar, with a 'Submit an Event' page) that lists other organizers' events across Douglas County; who publishes it was not stated on the pages read, so treat it as a listing site, not an organizer. The Tribe REST feed read for 10 November to 10 December 2026: 56 events on two pages, each with a structured venue (name, street address, city) and the organizer's own link in 'website'. Most are in Parker, Lone Tree and Highlands Ranch (PACE Center, Lone Tree Arts Center, Highlands Ranch Library), so the Castle Rock location filter is needed. 8 items are Castle Rock's: Book Bingo Night at Sinners and Saints, 221 Perry St (11 November), Veterans Day Fireworks Show at Philip S. Miller Park, 1375 W Plum Creek Parkway (11 November, 7 pm), Annual Tree Lighting, Free Concert and Holiday Drone Show at the Outlets (14 November, 4 pm), Castle Rock Starlighting (21 November, 2 pm; its venue is 'Downtown Castle Rock' with no city, so the filter must match the venue name or title), the 22nd Turkey ROCK Trot at the Douglas County Fairgrounds (26 November, 7:30 am), Festival Park Starlight Market at 300 2nd St (4 December 3 pm and 5 December 11 am) and Reindeer Games at Philip S. Miller Park (5 December, 1 pm). All 8 are worth a row and none is a regular; 4 of them the guide already lists from other sources (Book Bingo, Tree Lighting, Starlighting, Turkey ROCK Trot), so about 4 are new: the fireworks, the two Starlight Market days and Reindeer Games, which are Town events whose own pages on crgov.com (Season of the Star, Fireworks in Castle Rock) answer 403 from here. One more item, a Veterans Day Tour at Cherokee Ranch and Castle, is in Sedalia and the filter drops it. robots.txt disallows only /wp-admin/, so the REST path and the query string ingest adds are allowed. No title exclusions needed with the location filter on. The iCal export /events/?ical=1 is linked from the page and was not fetched. Because this is a third party's listing, each item should be checked against the organizer's link before it is published. Confirmed 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("Go 1 to 3", DECISIONS.md, "Twenty-four sources turned on"): the feed is one robots.txt allows, so it is read under honor.
